title: std::experimental::ranges::Permutable
summary: The Permutable concept specifies the common requirements of algorithms that reorder elements in place by moving or swapping them (for example, ranges::rotate).
html:
template< class I >
concept bool Permutable =
    ForwardIterator<I> &&
    IndirectlyMovableStorable<I, I> &&
    IndirectlySwappable<I, I>;
 (ranges TS)

The Permutable concept specifies the common requirements of algorithms that reorder elements in place by moving or swapping them (for example, ranges::rotate).
